segments.start_exact:
I awoke from profound sleep to find two black-swathed forms standing
silently beside me, their faces pale blurs
segments.end_exact:
he died, his stern face still
set in its harsh lines.
segments.summary: Franz awakens to the midnight summons and recalls his dying father's account of the curse and secret of the House of Kralitz.

cohesion.time: Present midnight framed by a flashback to the father's death-bed

erac.emotion: Solemn expectation and dread of the long-awaited summons
erac.reason: Franz recalls his father's warnings and the legend of the curse to understand the summons
erac.anticipation: He expects to be led to learn the secret of Kralitz in due time
erac.choice: Without a word he rises and follows his guides to fulfill the destiny

segments.reason: Opening frames recovery/recall and Franz's decision to follow, with recalled exposition; no on-stage conflict or outcome, so ERAC fits. Unified by the summons/memory thread.

segments.start_exact:
Deep in my memories, I had not noticed our path, but now the dark forms
of my guides paused beside a gap
segments.end_exact: a Kralitz would not acknowledge fear in the face of the devil himself!
segments.summary: Franz descends the hidden stairway to a subterranean cavern and beholds the monstrous demonic inhabitants amid conflicting horror and evil delight.

cohesion.place: Hidden stairway and the underground cavern beneath the castle

segments.reason: Time/place shift to the descent and cavern; primarily descriptive atmosphere and revelation of the setting without a goal-driven conflict/outcome, so narrative_scene.

segments.start_exact:
I stepped forward and confronted the warders, who were still seated
regarding me intently
segments.end_exact:
There was hell
beneath Castle Kralitz, and it held high carnival this night.
segments.summary: Franz confronts the seated warders, boldly announces himself, is pledged, drinks with them, and recognizes them as his undead ancestors, joining their feast.

cohesion.place: The stone banquet table in the underground cavern

gacd.goal: Franz seeks to confront the warders and assert himself as a Kralitz without showing fear
gacd.action: He steps to the throne, demands their purpose, and answers their pledge by drinking
gacd.conflict: Facing the terrifying undead ancestors while mastering his dread and revulsion

segments.reason: Goal (confront/assert), on-stage action (confronting, pledging, drinking) meeting fearful resistance, and a clear interim outcome (accepted as one of them). GACD satisfied.

segments.start_exact:
Presently we sang a fierce drinking-song, swinging the deep cups back
and forth in rhythm
segments.end_exact: we drained the pungent dregs of the liquor.
segments.summary: The saturnalia continues with singing, crossing a bridge to unnamable horrors, cosmic revelations, and a final pledge as the warders' time grows short.

cohesion.place: The cavern and beyond the arched bridge

segments.reason: Continuation of the revelry unified by time/place; mostly descriptive summary of experiences without goal-conflict-outcome structure, so narrative_scene.

segments.start_exact:
Then a strange lassitude fell upon me. With the others I turned my back
on the cavern
segments.end_exact:
my own name,
"Franz, twenty-first Baron Kralitz."
segments.summary: Ascending to the burial vaults, Franz is barred from leaving by the scarred warder and discovers the horrifying secret: his own occupied sarcophagus.

cohesion.place: The burial vaults beneath the castle

gacd.goal: Franz wishes to leave and return to the upper castle at dawn
gacd.action: He attempts to proceed onward to the upper parts of the castle
gacd.conflict: The scarred warder bars his path and refuses to let him pass

segments.reason: Time/place shifts to the vaults; Franz's goal to leave meets on-stage resistance (barred path) culminating in the disastrous revelation of his own tomb. GACD satisfied.
